label: N3E30
assumptions: Diagnostic grants declared 4-person ownership, legal equal-level phase/base talent cap, craft equipment at declared enhancement/cap10. No artifact/exclusive/boss equipment, constellations, food or innate HP resets between battles. Traveler public Q/E HOLD/basic, actual balanced companion AI. Initially full HP only; consecutive 2 fights without cooking or lodging. Before-reward native KO is separate from automatic 10% out-of-battle revival. No blanket guarantee of all rosters or natural acquisition.
